005package org.wpilib.epilogue.logging;
006
007import org.wpilib.epilogue.CustomLoggerFor;
008import org.wpilib.epilogue.logging.errors.ErrorHandler;
009import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
010
011/**
012 * Base class for class-specific generated loggers. Loggers are generated at compile time by the
013 * Epilogue annotation processor and are used at runtime for zero-overhead data logging. Users may
014 * also declare custom loggers, annotated with {@link CustomLoggerFor @CustomLoggerFor}, for
015 * Epilogue to pull in during compile time to use for logging third party types.
016 *
017 * @param <T> the type of data supported by the logger
018 */
019@SuppressWarnings("unused") // Used by generated subclasses
020public abstract class ClassSpecificLogger<T> {
021  private final Class<T> m_clazz;
022
023  private boolean m_disabled = false;
024
025  /**
026   * Instantiates the logger.
027   *
028   * @param clazz the Java class of objects that can be logged
029   */
030  protected ClassSpecificLogger(Class<T> clazz) {
031    this.m_clazz = clazz;
032  }
033
034  /**
035   * Updates an object's fields in telemetry.
036   *
037   * @param table the telemetry table to update
038   * @param object the object to update in the log
039   */
040  protected abstract void update(TelemetryTable table, T object);
041
042  /**
043   * Attempts to update telemetry. Will do nothing if the logger is {@link #disable() disabled}.
044   *
045   * @param table the telemetry table to log data to
046   * @param object the data object to log
047   * @param errorHandler the handler to use if logging raised an exception
048   */
049  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
050  public final void tryUpdate(TelemetryTable table, T object, ErrorHandler errorHandler) {
051    if (m_disabled) {
052      return;
053    }
054
055    try {
056      update(table, object);
057    } catch (Exception e) {
058      errorHandler.handle(e, this);
059    }
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Checks if this logger has been disabled.
064   *
065   * @return true if this logger has been disabled by {@link #disable()}, false if not
066   */
067  public final boolean isDisabled() {
068    return m_disabled;
069  }
070
071  /** Disables this logger. Any log calls made while disabled will be ignored. */
072  public final void disable() {
073    m_disabled = true;
074  }
075
076  /** Reenables this logger after being disabled. Has no effect if the logger is already enabled. */
077  public final void reenable() {
078    m_disabled = false;
079  }
080
081  /**
082   * Gets the type of the data this logger accepts.
083   *
084   * @return the logged data type
085   */
086  public final Class<T> getLoggedType() {
087    return m_clazz;
088  }
089}
